name: Seared Chicken Thighs with Creamy Zucchini and Cauliflower Purée

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large pot over medium heat.
While the pot heats up, pat the chicken thighs dry with paper towels. Season with salt and pepper on both sides.
instructions.secondary_message:
1.36 kg chicken thighs, boneless skinless
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Once the pot is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Working in batches if necessary, add chicken to the pot and pan-fry until cooked through and golden brown, 3-4 minutes per side. Transfer to a plate and loosely cover with aluminum foil. (Reserve pot with drippings.)
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ medium heads cauliflower
3 medium zucchini squash
3 tomatoes

instructions.primary_message: Fill another large pot with about 2-inches of hot water from the tap; cover and place over high heat.
Cut each cauliflower head into quarters, then trim off and discard the leaves and thick stem. Roughly chop into bite-sized pieces.
Once the water in the pot is boiling, add cauliflower, reduce heat to medium, and cook until tender, 10-12 minutes.
Meanwhile, halve zucchini lengthwise, then slice crosswise into ¼-inch thick half-moons.
Return pot (with drippings) to medium heat.
Once the pot is hot, add more oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add the zucchini, tomatoes, and spices; cook, stirring occasionally, until veggies start to soften, 4-5 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
¾ tsp Italian seasoning
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: While the veggies are cooking, cut cream cheese into small pieces. Finely grate Parmesan.
instructions.secondary_message:
¾ (227 g) block cream cheese
85 g Parmesan cheese

instructions.primary_message: Add cream cheese, Parmesan, and water to the pot with the zucchini. Cook, stirring occasionally, until the cheeses melt and combine, 2-3 minutes.
Return chicken to the pot with the creamy zucchini and cook, turning to coat, until warmed through, about 3 minutes. Remove from heat.
When the cauliflower is done, drain in a colander. Working in batches to best fit your blender, transfer cauliflower to the blender. Add oil, salt, and pepper; purée until smooth.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 ½ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide cauliflower purée, chicken, veggies, and sauce between plates. Enjoy!
